title: project-swarm 1.42.0: ship --wait-required-only, swarm ticket pipeline, worker check environments, adapter evidence + Codex retry, scaffold job|pr (T81, decision #341)
head: swarm-1.42-speed-pr
body:
## What
- `ship --wait-required-only` waits only on protected required checks and merges while optional checks keep running; ordinary ship and unprotected branches keep the full wait.
- `ticket MANIFEST --pr PAYLOAD` runs the guarded run, inspect, integrate, checks, bounded commit and ship stages as one pipeline with a durable resume journal that skips green stages.
- Shell worktrees link existing root dependencies read-only and executable, or prepare isolated environments with `run --sync`; a missing check environment now refuses instead of being scored as a pre-existing failure.
- Shell adapters keep streaming stdout/stderr evidence on disk, inspect shows a failed job's stderr tail, and Codex retries one transient connection blip only when no output changed.
- `scaffold job` covers uncovered tests and validates its manifest before writing; `scaffold pr` writes reviewable payloads whose mutation stub is refused by required-section shipping.
- This branch stacks on 1.41.0.

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

No ask-first gate or state mapping in this PR. Ten mutants from the contract §4 run with `swarm mutants --mutants-file` on the release tree: 10 killed, 0 survived, 0 invalid (each mutant run against its named killing test file).

| Mutant | What it breaks | Killing test | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (a) required-only mode assigns the full rollup | Merging only after required checks settle | `T81 required checks merge while optional checks run` | killed |
| (b) red-stage early return is disabled | Stopping a pipeline at its first red stage | `T81 pipeline stops at first red stage` | killed |
| (c) resume no longer skips green stages | Reusing saved green stage results on resume | `T81 resume skips every green stage` | killed |
| (d) spawn-shape classifier trigger returns null | Refusing instead of treating a missing environment as pre-existing | `T81 spawn-shaped failures cannot become pre-existing` | killed |
| (e) stderr sink append skips stderr | Retaining streaming evidence for a failed run | `T81 failed fake codex leaves streaming evidence` | killed |
| (f) codex blip regex or zero-output guard removed | Retrying only genuine blips with no written output | `T81 codex retries only blips with zero written outputs` | killed |
| (g) empty generated mutation marker; stub guard disabled | Refusing a required section that holds only a stub | `T81 required mutation section rejects literal stub` | killed |
| (h) scaffolded ignoreTests list left empty | Covering uncovered tests in a scaffolded job | `T81 scaffold job covers uncovered tests and validates` | killed |

## After merge
- Run `swarm update --yes` once 1.41.0 is installed.
- Route the next three project PRs through `swarm ticket` and measure wall time per merged PR against the 12.5–18.4 min baseline.
